findings.finding: Initial six sections were too compressed for beginners: pre-eclampsia unexplained, organ/fetal complications unnamed, drug risks abstract, diet and differential insufficient.
findings.resolution: Author expanded to36 specific bilingual claims; reviewer checked the final14 sections including definitions, low-glucose/intracranial workup, magnesium toxicity, excessive blood-pressure lowering, nutrition examples and follow-up.

findings.finding: WHO fact sheet simplifies proteinuria diagnosis; NICHD overview overemphasises early postpartum onset.
findings.resolution: CMA/NICE/RCOG retain organ-injury-without-proteinuria and delayed-postpartum possibilities; no exclusion based on one normal BP or urine result.

findings.finding: First-aid sources differ in wording about lateral position during versus after convulsions.
findings.resolution: Final text uses safe assistance, no forceful restraint or oral objects/food/medicine; keeps immediate emergency action for pregnancy/postpartum seizures.

findings.finding: Direct RCOG PDF inaccessible to reviewer.
findings.resolution: Reviewer independently retrieved the official-source indexed section4.3/page10 text; source scope is limited to that paragraph, not the full guideline.

findings.finding: Four critical claims used unsupported benefit_risk enum.
findings.resolution: Corrected to action/risk without changing medical text or evidence; existing two-source support retained.

scope_decisions.rationale: All14 sections address eclampsia before birth, during labour and after birth; unknown timing is not a separate treatment. No seizure is diagnosed from timing alone; epilepsy/metabolic/intracranial alternatives retained.
